name: @habib/hakim
description: Evidence-bound coding guidance for smaller, safer AI-assisted changes.

scripts.test: npm run test:product && npm run package:release
scripts.test:product: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
scripts.test:js: node tests/test_node_support_contract.mjs && node tests/test_behavioral_contract.mjs && node tests/test_claude_runtime_kernel.mjs && node tests/test_host_runtime_contract.mjs && node tests/test_copilot_operational_presence.mjs && node tests/test_copilot_objective_completion_truth.mjs && node tests/test_copilot_mode_state.mjs && node tests/test_copilot_mode_control.mjs && node tests/test_opencode_discoverability.mjs && node tests/test_opencode_plugin.mjs && node tests/test_hakim_opencode_lifecycle.mjs && node tests/test_hakim_opencode_adversarial_transactions.mjs && node tests/test_hakim_opencode_cli.mjs && node tests/test_hakim_opencode_package_surface.mjs && node tests/test_workflow_supply_chain_policy.mjs && node scripts/check_public_package_surface.mjs
scripts.test:py: python tests/test_audit_complexity.py && python tests/test_package_skill.py && python tests/test_release_checksums.py && python tests/test_release_sbom.py
scripts.test:node-compat: node tests/test_node_support_contract.mjs && node tests/test_host_runtime_contract.mjs && node tests/test_copilot_operational_presence.mjs && node tests/test_copilot_objective_completion_truth.mjs && node tests/test_copilot_mode_state.mjs && node tests/test_copilot_mode_control.mjs && node tests/test_opencode_discoverability.mjs && node tests/test_opencode_plugin.mjs && node tests/test_hakim_opencode_lifecycle.mjs && node tests/test_hakim_opencode_adversarial_transactions.mjs && node tests/test_hakim_opencode_cli.mjs && node tests/test_hakim_opencode_package_surface.mjs && node scripts/check_public_package_surface.mjs
scripts.package:skill: mkdir -p dist && python core/hakim-skill/scripts/package_skill.py --source core/hakim-skill --output dist/hakim-skill.zip && python scripts/verify_package.py dist/hakim-skill.zip
scripts.release:checksums: python scripts/build_release_checksums.py --artifact dist/hakim-skill.zip --artifact dist/hakim-sbom.cdx.json --checksums dist/SHA256SUMS --manifest dist/release-manifest.json
scripts.release:checksums:verify: python scripts/build_release_checksums.py --artifact dist/hakim-skill.zip --artifact dist/hakim-sbom.cdx.json --checksums dist/SHA256SUMS --manifest dist/release-manifest.json --verify
scripts.package:release: npm run package:skill && npm run release:sbom && npm run release:checksums && npm run release:sbom:verify && npm run release:checksums:verify
